title: Paul Pena
creator: CrossFit
description: Seven rounds, each for time, of a 100 m sprint, 19 heavy kettlebell swings and 10 burpee box jumps, with three minutes' rest between rounds. Honours U.S. Army Capt. Paul Pena, 82nd Airborne, killed by an IED while leading a patrol in the Arghandab River Valley, Afghanistan, in 2010. Score each round separately and try to hold the times level.
